# ty stub-environment constraints — the type-checking surface is pinned so
# upstream releases cannot drift the CI ty hard gate (the failure class that
# red-flagged the flip three times on 2026-10-17: CI re-resolves fresh every
# run, and any typing-bearing release shifts the diagnostic set).
#
# Scope: only the packages whose stubs meaningfully shape ty's inference over
# dnallm/ (verified against the environment the gate was green in). Everything
# else floats with the normal `.[full]` resolution — a typing change there
# surfaces as a normal diagnostic to fix, not gate flapping.
#
# Bump procedure: raise a pin deliberately -> run
#   uv venv /tmp/ty-stub-env --python 3.12 &&
#   uv pip install --python /tmp/ty-stub-env/bin/python -e ".[full]" \
#     -c .github/workflows/ty-stub-constraints.txt &&
#   uvx ty@0.0.84 check dnallm/ --python /tmp/ty-stub-env
# -> clear any new diagnostics in the same change. Never bump mid-fire.
torch==2.10.0
transformers==5.17.0
datasets==4.8.4
tokenizers==0.23.3
peft==0.21.2
accelerate==1.15.0
evaluate==0.4.6
altair==6.3.0
modelscope==1.40.2
numpy==2.2.0
pandas==3.0.6
pydantic==2.14.1
